title: Paloma Business Closure Terms
content:
### Who may close, and from which status

1. Only the owner can close a Paloma Business account, and only from status active. A past-due account first pays what it owes, and a suspended account cannot be closed by the owner.

### What must be settled

2. Closure is allowed only when the balance is 0.00 and the account has no open payout, an open payout being one with a submission record and no paid, cancelled or returned record. The owner withdraws the balance and every payout is paid, cancelled or returned first. Both are read from the account's records.

### Commitment

3. Closing before the commitment end date carries the early termination fee.

### Subscription refund window

4. When the owner closes the account within the plan's subscription refund window, in calendar days after the first subscription fee was charged, and no payout was submitted after that charge, that subscription fee is refunded with the refund reason "subscription refund window". No other subscription fee is ever refunded on closure.
5. The refund window is counted in calendar days from the entry date of the first subscription fee charge on the ledger, and a closure on the last day of the window is inside it.

### Termination by Paloma and records

6. Paloma terminates a suspended account only by its own decision.
7. Records are kept 5 years after closure.

### Window cases (hypothetical dates, a refund window of 14 days)

| First subscription fee charged | Payout submitted after it | Closure date | Refund of that subscription fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | No | 15 March, the last day of the window | Refunded |
| 1 March | No | 16 March | Not refunded |
| 1 March | Yes, on 3 March | 10 March | Not refunded |

A plan whose refund window is 0 days has no refund window.
